workflow.failure.notification.title: Workflow failed
workflow.failure.notification.body:
Hey,

Unfortunately we have some bad news.

One of your Dulno workflows has failed and requires your attention.

The reason for the error:

%s
Please log in to your Dulno account to fix the error.

If you have any questions about your problem, you can contact support@dulno.com at any time or create a ticket.

We can then help you to rectify the error.
